rows.title: Germinal products notifications have their own Upload documents page
rows.detail: Germinal products is its own set in the animals frontend, and each of its pages is a copy of the matching live animals page, taken once that page has been built. Upload documents is one of the germinal set's pages: only Additional details, the CPH number and the permanent address are left out of it. A trader working on a germinal products notification needs the same place to attach an ITAHC and the other documents a consignment needs, with the same guidance, the same four fields, the same virus-scan statuses, listing, download and removal, and with that notification's documents kept apart from any live animals notification's. The germinal data fields list names no germinal-specific document fields, so the copy asks exactly what the live animals page asks.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification, the overview's 'Upload documents' task opens a page headed 'Upload documents' with the caption 'Documents', the fields Document reference, Document type, Date of issue and Attachment in that order inside a 'File upload' card with a 'Save and add another' button, and 'Save and continue', 'Save and return to overview' and 'Cancel and return to overview' at the foot of the page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 2, 3; repo:frontend src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents)

On a germinal products notification, the Upload documents page's opening guidance, its 'Check which additional documents you must upload' table, its field hints, its Document type options and its error messages read word for word the same as on a live animals notification's Upload documents page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 2, 3; confluence:6497338582 §Germinal Data Elements)

On a germinal products notification, a document saved with the reference 'ITAHC-001', a document type, a date of issue and a PDF file is listed with a 'Scanning for virus' tag and then a 'Check completed' tag, its 'View file' link downloads the file that was attached, and it is still listed after the page is reloaded. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:prototype-dr2-1 TRACE C actions 92-95)

On a germinal products notification, Save and add another with nothing entered shows an error summary titled 'There is a problem' listing, in order, 'Enter a document reference', 'Select a document type', 'Enter a date of issue' and 'Upload a document', each repeated inline on its own field. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:animals-fit p22-068)

On a germinal products notification, Remove takes a listed document off the page straight away with no confirmation, and it is not listed after the page is reloaded. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:animals-fit p22-058)

In a germinal products notification's opening run, Save and continue on Upload documents goes to the germinal set's Consignment addresses page; opened from the germinal overview, the 'Back' link and Save and continue both return to that overview. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 2, 39)

A document added on a germinal products notification is not listed on any live animals notification's Upload documents page, and a germinal products notification cannot be opened through the live animals set's Upload documents page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 4, 6)

The germinal products Upload documents page has no serious or critical axe violations (WCAG 2.2 AA) when empty, in its error state and with a saved document that has scanned clean. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 15)

openQuestions: Whether the rule that Save and return to overview makes exactly the same checks as Save and continue reaches the germinal products set is left open: ruling:sam-2026-10-26 (p1-024) names only live animals and high-risk plants. Default, from req-1825: the germinal page is copied from the live animals page after that change has landed, so it carries the same behaviour. Build it that way and say so.
notes: One slice only; nothing to combine. Every other documents requirement is held by a theme already split off, so this area's only row is the germinal copy.

Ordering: it must land after every live animals documents row that can build now (the documents split workarea's inc-031, inc-033, inc-034 and inc-035, carried today as externalDependsOn on shared/design-release-2-1/themes/documents), so the copy carries their changes, and after the germinal set's own rows that create the set and its mount, its overview, its step order and return rules, and its category scoping (inc-176 today; the combiner adds the others by their ids). The blocked 50MB row is not waited on: when it unblocks it changes both sets' pages.

Keeps its theme, germinal-products, and its existing id. The backend's accompanying-document endpoints are keyed by notification reference and need no change for a germinal notification, so backend is not in repos. The end-to-end, accessibility and security specs sit under the tests repo's animals project in the germinal-products folders, with page objects beside the other germinal page objects; the security spec drives the germinal documents routes through the ZAP scan. Criteria assert the page by heading, copy and destination, never by a literal path. Plants mapping: a straight copy within animals, no plants change (plants-common-mapping-2026-10-09.json inc-179).

Design snagging merged to main on 23 October, so the live Upload documents page this row copies has already changed: the File upload card is full width with the fields and drop zone in a two-thirds column inside it, there is no empty-state line, the action column is right-aligned, the date example hint is one shared copy key and the date picker is the house calendar, Welsh has its own file-type list joining, and refusals and save fallbacks are logged. The germinal copy takes these as they are, after the documents theme's rows land.

ruling:sam-2026-10-26 changes nothing here beyond the open question above: it rules on the two frontends it names, and this row copies the live animals page after that ruling's change has landed in it.
